sloka: जटायुः तम् अतिक्रम्य तुण्डेन अस्य खग अधिपः ।वाम बाहून् दश तदा व्यपाहरत् अरिन्दमः ॥३-५१-३८॥
transliteration: jaṭāyuḥ tam atikramya tuṇḍena asya khaga adhipaḥ ।vāma bāhūn daśa tadā vyapāharat arindamaḥ ॥3-51-38॥

translations.english: Then Jatayu, lord of the birds, subduer of enemies, overpowered Ravana and dismembered his ten left arms with his beak.
